//: The vocabulary of things an agent can actually DO. Roles are named bundles of these; routing (request_review, send_message to a role) resolves through them. A capability that is not listed here cannot be granted — `collab check-config` fails on an unknown name, which is how a typo stops being a silently unroutable agent.

capabilities.run_tests: Run the test runners declared in runners.json.
capabilities.run_gates: Run the repository guard scripts and preflight.
capabilities.review_code: Produce a structured review verdict on someone else's work.
capabilities.inspect_git: Read git status, log and diff.
capabilities.run_application: Build, install and drive the app on a simulator or device.
capabilities.use_mcp_tool: Call other MCP servers registered for this project.
capabilities.research: Read documentation and external sources and summarise them.
capabilities.record_decision: Write a decision record that binds later work.
